title: Network Port Inventory Checker
description: Checks exposed port inventory for unapproved exposure, a recent inventory date, and owner.
decision: Checks exposed port inventory for unapproved exposure, a recent inventory date, and owner.
limitations: Uses caller-declared evidence only; does not verify external systems, legal requirements, or real-world truth. Human review remains required.
inputs: A JSON object containing the documented fields. Numeric thresholds are deterministic and visible in agent.py.
